F1_permission_denied.scenario: Traveler taps 'Remind me' and denies POST_NOTIFICATIONS / notification permission
F1_permission_denied.expected: App remains 100% usable; reminder not scheduled; contextual error message displayed; option to open Settings available without nagging modals
F1_permission_denied.actual: PASS: Permission launcher catches denial, displays non-intrusive snackbar, does not schedule alarm

F2_departure_already_passed.scenario: Traveler attempts to set a reminder for a departure that has already passed today
F2_departure_already_passed.expected: No alarm scheduled; user informed calmly with 'This scheduled departure has already passed'
F2_departure_already_passed.actual: PASS: TransitReminderCalculator returns null; ReminderScheduleResult.PassedDeparture returned and handled

F3_app_killed.scenario: User schedules a 15m reminder and force-quits / swipes away the app
F3_app_killed.expected: AlarmManager RTC_WAKEUP / iOS UNUserNotificationCenter trigger fires independently of app process state
F3_app_killed.actual: PASS: Native OS alarm facility handles wake event independently of foreground process

F4_device_offline.scenario: Device enters airplane mode or transit blackspot after scheduling
F4_device_offline.expected: Local notification still triggers on schedule; notification copy remains truthful ('Scheduled departure')
F4_device_offline.actual: PASS: Zero network required for local alarm execution; copy explicitly states 'Scheduled timetable only'

F5_route_deleted_or_unavailable.scenario: Notification deep link tapped for a route that is no longer found in catalog
F5_route_deleted_or_unavailable.expected: Deep link router falls back gracefully to Transit directory; zero unhandled crashes
F5_route_deleted_or_unavailable.actual: PASS: OTravelzApp opens TransitDirectoryScreen safely if route lookup returns null

F6_user_changes_device_timezone.scenario: Device timezone changed from IST to London GMT (UTC+0)
F6_user_changes_device_timezone.expected: Timetable departure remains IST (08:30 IST); universal trigger moment remains 08:15 IST (02:45 UTC)
F6_user_changes_device_timezone.actual: PASS: Unit tests verify triggerEpochMs maps to exact universal epoch timestamp matching 08:15 IST

F7_sign_out_after_scheduling.scenario: Traveler signs in, sets departure reminder, then signs out in You tab
F7_sign_out_after_scheduling.expected: Local scheduled reminder remains active and fires normally; local app remains usable
F7_sign_out_after_scheduling.actual: PASS: Reminders are device-scoped in ReminderStore and AlarmManager; logout does not wipe local reminders
